tools.name: read_source
tools.description: Read an admitted exact current source region.

tools.name: replace_source
tools.description: Propose an exact unique observed replacement; host admission is required.

tools.name: list_repository
tools.description: List authorized snapshot resources, sizes and read/edit permissions. Metadata only, not acquired source.

tools.name: search_source
tools.description: Search existing file/symbol/window retrieval by query. Returns ranked metadata, not source. Read selected ranges separately; full file lengths are supplied.

tools.name: inspect_and_validate_change
tools.description: Inspect authorized changes and execute host-fixed focused acceptance. No command/scope arguments.
